videoAlignment.method: Original source frames decoded without resampling. ffprobe best_effort_timestamp_time confirms25fps. Adjacent native encoded frames were visually inspected for first fan appearance, actual template change, or countdown removal matching accepted native sound callbacks. Each heat uses its own measured GO anchor; later driving cuts retain the original continuous native audio at this measured origin. No assumed page-creation offset, synthetic sounds, speed or pitch changes.
